suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 applies to JetBrains Kotlin versions before 2.4.20 and describes unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build cache metadata. The desktop app consumes kotlin-stdlib as runtime support for OkHttp; it does not execute Kotlin compiler/build-cache tooling. As of 2026-07-08, Kotlin 2.4.0 is the latest stable release and 2.4.20 is planned for September 2026, so this suppression must be revisited when a stable fixed release is published.
